blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Household robots need to continually navigate to different objects in the same environment, many of which are small and portable, such as tools and toys. Their small visual footprint and frequent occlusion make reliable observation difficult, and they may be moved by people without the robot observing the changes. We formulate this challenging task as Lifelong Small-object Navigation in Changing Object Layouts ( LiSoNav-COL ). Agents must seek suitable viewpoints for reliable observation, accumulate and reuse scene knowledge to efficiently locate subsequent targets, and update outdated memory after object relocation. To eliminate the need for prior scene scanning, we also require agents to start navigation with empty scene memory. Although practical, this task still lacks benchmarks designed around its defining assumptions. To bridge this gap, we introduce LiSoNav-Eval , a dedicated benchmark spanning 28 indoor scenes with 45 small-object categories. Its lifelong navigation sequences include both unchanged and relocated targets to evaluate memory reuse and adaptation to object relocation. To address this challenging task, we propose a navigation method based on multi-view Inspection with Viewpoint-Anchored Memory, dubbed IVAM-Nav . IVAM-Nav actively observes supporting surfaces from complementary viewpoints for reliable small-object perception and anchors the resulting memory to their observation viewpoints, supporting relational memory reuse and revalidation under similar viewing conditions.
Extensive experiments on LiSoNav-Eval demonstrate favorable performance of IVAM-Nav against representative methods. Benchmark analyses also show that smaller objects, larger environments, and longer relocation distances pose greater challenges. The dataset and code are available here .
blocks.zh:
家用机器人需要持续地导航到同一个环境中的不同物体,其中许多是小而可携带的,如工具和玩具. 他们小的视觉足迹和频繁的被隔离使得可靠的观察难以进行,他们可能会被没有机器人观察变化的人所感动. 我们提出这项具有挑战性的任务,即改变物体布局的终身小物体导航(LiSoNav-COL)。 代理人必须寻找合适的视角进行可靠的观测,积累并再利用场景知识来有效定位后续目标,并在物体迁移后更新已过时的内存. 为了消除前作场景扫描的需要,我们也要求特工开始以空场景内存来进行导航. 这项任务虽然切实可行,但仍然缺乏围绕其定义性假设制定的基准。 为了弥合这一差距,我们引入了LiSoNav-Eval,这是一个跨越28个室内场景、45个小物体类别的专用基准。 它的终身导航序列既包括不变的目标,也包括迁移的目标来评价内存再利用和适应物体迁移. 为了应对这一具有挑战性的任务,我们提出了一种以Viewpoint-Anchored Memory为主的多视图检查为基础的导航方法,被誉为IVAM-Nav. IVAM-Nav从互补角度积极观测支持地表,以获取可靠的小物体感知,并将由此产生的记忆固定在观测角度,支持关系记忆再用,并在类似取景条件下重新验证.
关于LiSoNav-Eval的广泛实验表明,IVAM-Nav在对抗代表性方法方面表现良好。 基准分析还表明,较小的物体、更大的环境和较长的迁移距离构成更大的挑战。 这里有数据集和代码。

blocks.en: Figure 1: An example navigation sequence in LiSoNav-Eval, in which the agent is instructed to find the CAN on the table, the SPOON on the counter, the NEWSPAPER on the table, and other targets in sequence. Starting with no prior scene memory, the agent searches for the CAN while constructing memory from observed objects, which is later reused to find the SPOON . Between episodes, randomly selected objects are relocated without the agent observing the changes. When searching for the NEWSPAPER , the agent first revisits the remembered location, finds the newspaper missing, updates the scene memory, and then locates the newspaper elsewhere. This example illustrates how LiSoNav-Eval evaluates small-object navigation as agents accumulate scene knowledge, reuse it across tasks, and respond to changes in object locations.
blocks.zh: 图 1:LiSoNav-Eval中一个实例导航序列,其中指示代理在桌上找到CAN,在柜台上找到SPOON,在桌上找到NEWSPAPER,并按顺序找到其他目标. 从没有前作场景内存开始,代理在从被观测对象构建内存时搜索CAN,后被再用以找到SPOON. 在片段之间,随机选择的对象在不观察变化的代理设备的情况下被移动. 在搜索"NewSPAPER"时,代理商首先重温被记住的地点,发现报纸缺失,更新了场景记忆,再将报纸定位到其他地方. 这个例子说明了LiSoNav-Eval在代理器积累场景知识,跨任务再利用时如何评价小对象导航,并应对物体位置的变化.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Object-goal navigation requires embodied agents to search for and navigate to target objects specified by images or language ( Krantz et al., 2023 ; Zhu et al., 2021 ) . In household environments, robots may repeatedly perform such tasks in the same scene, motivating lifelong navigation that retains and reuses experience across successive tasks ( Khanna et al., 2024b ) . Scene memory supports this process by preserving previously acquired object information to reduce redundant exploration.
blocks.zh: 对象-目标导航需要被体现的代理搜索和导航,以瞄准由图像或语言指定的对象(克兰茨等,2023;朱等,2021.). 在家庭环境中,机器人可能在同一场景中反复执行这类任务,从而激发终生的导航能力,在连续的任务中保留和再利用经验(Khanna等,2024b.)。 场景内存通过保存先前获得的物体信息来减少冗余探索来支持这一过程.

blocks.en:
In everyday household activities, many objects that robots need to locate and manipulate are small, portable items, such as tools and toys. People may move objects unnoticed by the robot, leaving its scene memory outdated and requiring verification and updates. These objects also occupy only a small portion of the visual field and are often occluded, making them difficult to observe clearly ( Wang and Soh, 2023 ) .
These real-world challenges motivate us to study Li felong S mall- o bject Nav igation in C hanging O bject L ayouts ( LiSoNav-COL ). In this task, an agent starts with no prior scene memory and navigates to successive small-object goals within the same environment, incrementally acquiring scene knowledge throughout the navigation. Given that unobserved object relocations may render its memory outdated, the agent must learn to reuse accumulated scene knowledge while adapting to these changes for accurate and efficient navigation. Starting with an empty memory eliminates the need for a separate scene-scanning phase in real-world applications.
blocks.zh:
在日常的家庭活动中,机器人需要定位和操纵的许多物品是小型的,可携带的物品,如工具和玩具. 人们可能会移动被机器人所忽视的物体,使其场景记忆已经过时并需要验证和更新. 这些物体还只占据了视觉场的一小部分并经常被被占据,使其难以清晰地观测(Wang and Soh, 2023.).
这些现实世界的挑战促使我们研究 Li Felong S商场 - o bject Nav igation in C hanging O bject L ayouts (LiSoNav-COL. ). 在这个任务中,一个代理开始没有先前的场景内存,并在同一个环境中导航到相继的小对象目标,在整个导航过程中逐渐获得场景知识. 鉴于无人观察物体的迁移可能使其内存过时,代理人必须学会重新利用所积累的场景知识,同时适应这些变化以准确而高效地导航。 从一个空的内存开始,消除了在现实世界应用中单独进行场景扫描阶段的需要.

blocks.en: Existing navigation benchmarks adopt task assumptions that differ from those of LiSoNav-COL. The mainstream lifelong navigation benchmarks ( Wani et al., 2020 ; Khanna et al., 2024b ; Wang et al., 2026 ) mainly evaluate experience reuse in static scenes, where target locations remain unchanged across subtasks. OpenIN ( Tang et al., 2025 ) evaluates sequential navigation after object relocation, but starts with a preconstructed scene graph and relocates objects before the task sequence begins. This setting assesses the use of prior scene knowledge after relocation, rather than its online acquisition and maintenance through repeated changes. Meanwhile, the small-object navigation benchmark ( Wang and Soh, 2023 ) focuses on perception and target search in static scenes under a single-goal setting. These evaluation settings do not jointly capture the requirements of LiSoNav-COL: acquiring scene knowledge from an initially empty memory, reusing it across small-object navigation tasks, and adapting to repeated object relocation.
blocks.zh: 现有导航基准采用的任务假设与LiSoNav-COL不同。 主流终生通航基准(Wani等,2020;Khanna等,2024b;Wang等,2026)主要评价静态场景中的经验再利用,各分任务中的目标位置保持不变. OpenIN(Tang等,2025年)在对象迁移后评价相继导航,但在任务顺序开始前先从预构的场景图开始并迁移对象. 这一设定评估了迁移后对先前场景知识的利用,而不是通过反复的改变进行在线获取和维护. 同时,小物体导航基准(Wang and Soh, 2023)在单一目标设定下注重静态场景中的感知与目标搜索. 这些评价设置没有共同捕捉到LiSoNav-COL的要求:从最初的空内存中获取场景知识,在小对象导航任务中重用,并适应重复的物体迁移.

blocks.en:
To support systematic evaluation of LiSoNav-COL, we introduce LiSoNav-Eval , a new benchmark comprising navigation sequences and an evaluation protocol for this task.
Figure 1 presents an illustrative example of our benchmark, where the agent completes
a sequence of small-object navigation subtasks (each corresponding to a specific goal) in the same environment, starting with no prior scene memory and retaining the knowledge acquired during task execution. Specifically, each navigation sequence comprises multiple episodes, each containing several navigation subtasks. Object locations remain unchanged within each episode, while randomly selected objects are relocated between episodes without the agent observing the changes.
By including both unchanged and relocated targets, LiSoNav-Eval preserves opportunities to benefit from previously acquired knowledge while testing adaptation when remembered locations become outdated. Together, these settings support the evaluation of small-object navigation as agents accumulate scene knowledge, reuse it across tasks, and respond to changes in object layouts.
blocks.zh:
为了支持对LiSoNav-COL的系统评价,我们介绍了LiSoNav-Eval,这是一个新的基准,由导航序列和这项任务的评价协议组成。
图1举例说明了我们的基准,即代理人完成
在同一环境中,一个小对象导航子任务的序列(每个任务都对应特定目标),从没有前作场景内存开始,保留任务执行期间获得的知识. 具体来说,每个导航序列包含多集,每个集包含多个导航子任务. 对象位置在每集内保持不变,而随机选择的对象则在各集间移动而无需代理观察变化.
LiSoNav-Eval既包括了不变的目标,也包括了迁移的目标,从而保留了从以前获得的知识中受益的机会,同时在人们记得的地点过时时测试适应性。 这些设置加在一起支持对小对象导航的评价,因为代理器会积累场景知识,在任务之间重复使用,并对对象布局的变化作出反应.

blocks.en:
In LiSoNav-COL, incomplete or unreliable small-object observations can limit the effectiveness of existing scene-memory methods ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Tang et al., 2025 ) . Object relocation compounds these observation difficulties, making memory reuse and revalidation more challenging.
In this paper, we propose IVAM-Nav , a lifelong small-object navigation
method based on multi-view I nspection and V iewpoint- A nchored M emory, to address these challenges. Our key idea is to actively inspect the supporting surfaces where the target may be located from multiple viewpoints and anchor the memory to these viewpoints.
Specifically, the agent acquires reliable and complementary observations around potential supporting surfaces and stores them with their camera poses and semantic associations. These records enable reobservation under similar viewing conditions to effectively verify and update the memory.
Extensive experiments on LiSoNav-Eval demonstrate the effectiveness of our algorithm. Our contributions can be summarized as:
blocks.zh:
在LiSoNav-COL中,不完整或不可靠的小物体观测可以限制现有场景-记忆方法的有效性(黄等,2026;杨等,2025;唐等,2025.). 物体迁移增加了这些观测困难,使内存再利用和再验证更具挑战性.
在本文中,我们提出 IVAM-Nav, 一个终身的小物体导航
基于多视图 I spection 和 V iewpoint - A nchored M emory 的方法,以应对这些挑战. 我们的主要想法是积极检查目标可能从多个角度定位的支撑地表,并将内存固定在这些观点上.
具体地说,该剂在潜在支撑面周围获得可靠和互补的观测结果,并用相机姿势和语义关联来储存. 这些记录使得在类似取景条件下的再观测能够有效地验证并更新内存.
对LiSoNav-Eval的广泛实验证明了我们算法的有效性. 我们的贡献可归纳为:

blocks.en: • We formulate LiSoNav-COL, a new task for lifelong small-object navigation from empty scene memory under changing object layouts. We also introduce LiSoNav-Eval, a dedicated benchmark for evaluating agent performance on this task. • We propose IVAM-Nav, which constructs a viewpoint-anchored graph memory through active multi-view inspection. This design supports relational memory reuse and memory revalidation under similar viewing conditions, enabling robust navigation. • Extensive experiments on LiSoNav-Eval demonstrate favorable performance of IVAM-Nav against representative methods, and benchmark analyses identify smaller objects, larger environments, and longer relocation distances as persistent challenges.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 我们制定 LiSoNav-COL,这是在改变对象布局下从空景内存中进行终身小对象导航的新任务. 我们还采用了LiSoNav-Eval,这是评价代理人在这项任务方面的业绩的专门基准。 我们提议IVAM-Nav,它通过积极的多视图检查构建了一种观点-焦虑的图记. 这种设计支持在相类似的取景条件下进行关系内存再利用和内存再验证,使能进行强力导航. • LiSoNav-Eval的广泛实验表明,IVAM-Nav对照代表性方法表现良好,基准分析确定较小的物体、更大的环境和较长的迁移距离是长期的挑战。

blocks.en: We formulate LiSoNav-COL, a new task for lifelong small-object navigation from empty scene memory under changing object layouts. We also introduce LiSoNav-Eval, a dedicated benchmark for evaluating agent performance on this task.
blocks.zh: 我们制定 LiSoNav-COL,这是在改变对象布局下从空景内存中进行终身小对象导航的新任务. 我们还介绍了LiSoNav-Eval,这是评价代理商在这项任务方面的业绩的专用基准。

blocks.en: We propose IVAM-Nav, which constructs a viewpoint-anchored graph memory through active multi-view inspection. This design supports relational memory reuse and memory revalidation under similar viewing conditions, enabling robust navigation.
blocks.zh: 我们提议IVAM-Nav,它通过积极的多视图检查构建了一种观点-焦虑的图记. 这种设计支持在相类似的取景条件下进行关系内存再利用和内存再验证,使能进行强力导航.

blocks.en: Extensive experiments on LiSoNav-Eval demonstrate favorable performance of IVAM-Nav against representative methods, and benchmark analyses identify smaller objects, larger environments, and longer relocation distances as persistent challenges.
blocks.zh: 关于LiSoNav-Eval的广泛实验表明,IVAM-Nav相对于代表性方法的有利表现,基准分析确定较小的物体、更大的环境和较长的迁移距离是持续的挑战。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Lifelong navigation in changing environments. Existing navigation tasks and benchmarks span single-goal, sequential, and lifelong settings in largely static scenes ( Chaplot et al., 2020 ; Krantz et al., 2023 ; Zhu et al., 2021 ; Wani et al., 2020 ; Khanna et al., 2024b ; Miao et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2025 ; WANG et al., 2026 ) , while dynamic settings consider moving objects and spatiotemporal retrieval ( Kurenkov et al., 2023 ; Dorbala et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Bogenberger et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . Most closely related to our setting, OpenIN studies changing object layouts but requires a preconstructed scene representation before navigation, with its evaluation data and implementation currently unavailable ( Tang et al., 2025 ) . LiSoNav-Eval instead evaluates lifelong small-object navigation from empty memory under changing object layouts.
blocks.zh: 不断变化的环境中的终身通航. 现有的导航任务和基准跨越基本静态场景中的单一目标、相继和终生环境(Chaplot等,2020年;Krantz等,2023年;Zhu等,2021年;Wani等,2020年;Khanna等,2024年b;Miao等,2026年;Yu等,2025年;WANG等,2026年),而动态环境考虑移动物体和瞬间检索(Kurenkov等,2023年;Dorbala等,2026年;Jiang等,2025年;Bogenberger等,2026年;Chen等,2025年)。 OpenIN研究改变对象布局, 但需要在导航前预先构建场景显示, 目前还没有评估数据和实施(Tang等人, 2025年)。 LiSoNav-Eval转而在改变对象布局下从空内存中评价终身的小对象导航.

blocks.en: Memory construction, reuse, and revalidation. Existing navigation methods construct and query scene memory through object- or scene-centric graphs, visual observations, and spatial representations ( Gu et al., 2024 ; Werby et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Chang et al., 2024 ; Wang and Soh, 2023 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Ge et al., 2026 ) , while dynamic-memory methods further update or reassess stored information based on new observations ( Tang et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Yan et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Ko et al., 2025 ) . APRR and MSGNav actively adjust viewpoints after target detection or localization for manipulation or final-view selection ( Qin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, IVAM-Nav builds reliable small-object memory via complementary multi-view inspection and uses acquisition viewpoints as persistent anchors for relational retrieval and revalidation.
blocks.zh: 记忆构造,再利用,再验证. 现有导航方法通过以物体为中心或以场景为核心的图表,视觉观测,和空间表示构建并查询场景内存(顾等,2024;韦比等,2024;杨等,2025;刘等,2025;蒋等,2025;朱等,2025;张等,2024;王等,同. ; 2023; 徐等, 2026; Ge等, 2026) ,而动态记忆方法则根据新的观测结果进一步更新或重新评估所储存的信息(唐等,2025;江等,2025;刘等,2025;颜等,2025;赵等,2026;高等,2025). APRR和MSGNav在目标检测或本地化后积极调整观点以进行操纵或最终取景选择(秦等,2025;黄等,2026. 相形之下,IVAM-Nav通过互补多视图检查来建立可靠的小对象内存,并使用获取视角作为持续的锚来进行关系检索和再验证.

blocks.en: 3 LiSoNav-Eval Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3 LiSoNav-Eval基准

blocks.en: 3.1 Task Definition
blocks.zh: 3.1 任务定义

blocks.en: The agent is required to complete a sequence of navigation subtasks (each corresponding to a small-object goal) in the same indoor environment with no prior scene memory. It needs to retain the knowledge acquired during subtask execution to facilitate the subsequent subtasks. The lifelong navigation sequence in LiSoNav-Eval spans three or four consecutive episodes, with each episode containing two or three navigation subtasks. Figure 1 illustrates such a sample.
blocks.zh: 该剂需要在同一室内环境中完成一系列的导航子任务(每个都对应一个小对象目标),没有先前的场景记忆. 它需要保留在子任务执行期间获得的知识来为后续子任务提供方便. LiSoNav-Eval的终身通航序列连续三到四集,每集包含两到三个通航子任务. 图1说明了这种样本。

blocks.en: The goal object of each subtask is specified by a natural language instruction. To clearly specify the target object, the instruction is designed to include coarse contextual cues, such as its supporting surface or nearby surroundings , while leaving its exact current location unspecified. This formulation also aligns with how people typically describe the location of a small object in a home environment. Herein, we show two instruction samples:
blocks.zh: 每个子任务的目标对象由自然语言指令来指定. 为明确指定目标对象,该指令旨在包括粗糙的上下文提示,例如其支持的地表或附近环境,同时未指明其目前的确切位置。 这种提法也符合人们一般如何描述一个小物体在家庭环境中的位置. 在这里,我们显示两个指示样本:

blocks.en: • Instruction 1: Find the tissue box on the speckled countertop near the sink. • Instruction 2: Find the turquoise Lego Duplo brick on a small wooden table next to a bed.

blocks.en:
We also provide an optional reference image to aid small-object recognition, which reveals no information about the current location of the target. In real-world applications, such images could be obtained through online searches or other external sources.
Within an episode, object locations remain unchanged, and subtasks are executed sequentially from the terminal pose of the preceding subtask. Objects are relocated only between episodes to render memory outdated, not during navigation, to avoid turning the task into online tracking of moving objects.
blocks.zh:
我们还提供了辅助小物体识别的可选参考图像,该图像显示没有关于目标当前位置的信息. 在现实世界的应用中,这种图像可以通过在线搜索或其他外部来源获得.
在一集中,物体位置保持不变,子任务从上一个子任务的终端姿势相继执行. 对象仅在相片间被迁移,以使内存过时,而不是在导航时被迁移,以避免将任务转化为移动对象的在线跟踪.

blocks.en: A subtask is successful when the agent stops within 1.5 m of the valid instance matching the target description. Each subtask has a path-length budget of 10 times the shortest geodesic distance from the start to the target, and terminates immediately once this budget is exceeded. This budget allows exploration and recovery from outdated location information after object relocation while limiting excessive search. We report standard navigation metrics (SR and SPL), together with Historical Revisit (HR) and Relocated-target SR. Detailed definitions are provided in 5.1 .
blocks.zh: 当代理在匹配目标描述的有效实例1.5米以内停止时,子任务是成功的 。 每个子任务的路径长度预算为从开始到目标最短的大地测量距离的10倍,一旦超过这一预算,就立即终止. 这一预算允许在物体迁移后对过时的地点信息进行探索和回收,同时限制过度搜索。 我们报告标准导航量度(SR和SPL),以及历史重访(HR)和重测目标(SR)。 5.1提供了详细的定义。

blocks.en: Table 1: Comparison of LiSoNav-Eval with existing lifelong navigation benchmarks. † \dagger indicates that the corresponding evaluation data are not publicly released.
blocks.zh: 表1: LiSoNav-Eval与现有终生导航基准的比较。 &\dagger 表示相应的评价数据不公开发布.

blocks.en: 3.2 LiSoNav-Eval Dataset
blocks.zh: 3.2 LiSoNav-Eval数据集

blocks.en: Scene and object assets. We use indoor scenes from HM3D ( Ramakrishnan et al., 2021 ) and select 82 diverse small-object instances across 45 categories from YCB ( Calli et al., 2015 ) and HSSD ( Khanna et al., 2024a ) , covering portable household items such as cups, balls, tools, and fruits.
blocks.zh: 场景和物体资产. 我们使用来自HM3D(Ramakrishnan等,2021年)的室内场景,从YCB(Calli等,2015年)和HSSD(Khanna等,2024年a)中从45个类别中选择82个不同的小物体,涵盖杯子,球,工具,水果等便携式家用物品.

blocks.en:
Dataset construction. To construct a lifelong navigation sequence, we first populate an HM3D scene with small objects. We use Qwen-VL-Max ( Bai et al., 2023 ) to identify suitable supporting surfaces and define category-specific placement rules. These rules exclude implausible object-surface combinations, such as placing food on beds.
We also limit local object density to avoid excessive clutter and occlusion that would make small objects unnecessarily difficult to observe. Based on these rules, we randomly generate an initial object configuration for each scene and sample the target objects episode by episode. Targets selected in the first episode remain at their initial locations. In each subsequent episode, a selected target has a probability of being relocated to another compatible supporting surface, preserving plausible object placements after relocation.
The same target is not selected more than once within an episode, but may reappear in later episodes, allowing previously acquired knowledge to be useful for subsequent subtasks.
blocks.zh:
数据集构建. 为了构建一个终身的导航序列,我们首先将HM3D场景与小物体相融合. 我们使用Quen-VL-Max(Bai等,2023年)来确定合适的支撑面并界定特定类别的放置规则. 这些规则排除了不可信的物体-表面组合,如将食物放入床上等.
我们还限制局部物体密度,以避免过度杂乱和被遮住,使小物体不必要地难以观测。 基于这些规则,我们随机生成每个场景的初始对象配置,并逐集地取出目标对象集. 第一集中选择的目标仍然停留在最初的位置. 在随后的每集中,一个被选中的目标都有被迁移到另一个相容的辅助地表的概率,在迁移后保留了可信的物体放置.
同一目标在一集内没有被选中不止一次,但可能在后一集重新出现,使得之前获得的知识对后一子任务有用.

blocks.en: Since LiSoNav-COL starts from empty scene memory, relocating an object that was not previously observed may not invalidate any acquired memory. To increase the likelihood that relocation creates stale memory, we preferentially sample objects in the same semantic region as, and within 5 ​ m 5\,\mathrm{m} of, a previously selected target, as they are more likely to have been observed during earlier navigation.
blocks.zh: 由于LiSoNav-COL是从空场景内存开始的,迁移一个先前没有被观察到的对象可能不会使任何已获得的内存无效. 为了增加迁移产生 stale memory 的可能性,我们优先在同一个语义区和5 m 5\,\ mathrm{m} 5 m以内对对象进行取样,因为这些对象更有可能在早期的导航中被观察到。

blocks.en: Dataset verification. To ensure each target is visually identifiable from a suitable viewpoint, we sample observations around every target with the target near the view center. We use Qwen-VL-Max to assess target recognizability and manually remove overly difficult cases.
blocks.zh: 数据集验证. 为了确保每个目标从一个合适的角度可以视觉识别,我们用在取景中心附近的每个目标周围的观测样本. 我们用Quen-VL-Max来评估目标识别性,并手动去除过于困难的案件.

blocks.en: Dataset annotation. We provide a textual description for each of the 82 small-object instances, emphasizing attributes that distinguish visually similar instances. For coarse contextual cues, we use a real observation around the target location and Qwen-VL-Max to generate coarse descriptions of the supporting surface and available surroundings using attributes such as category, color, and material, while excluding fine-grained spatial details that could reveal the target’s precise location.
blocks.zh: 数据集注释. 我们为82个小对象实例中的每一个提供了文字描述,强调区分视觉相近实例的属性. 对于粗糙的上下文提示,我们用真实的观察在目标位置和Quen-VL-Max周围用分类、颜色和材料等属性来生成支持面和可用环境的粗糙描述,同时排除能揭示目标准确位置的细微的空间细节。

blocks.en: Dataset statistics. As shown in Table 1 , LiSoNav-Eval contains 145 lifelong navigation sequences from 28 HM3D scenes, comprising 500 episodes and 1,199 subtasks across 45 categories and 82 small-object instances. 545 (45.45%) of these subtasks involve relocated targets. Each navigation sequence contains 8.27 subtasks on average. Compared with OpenIN ( Tang et al., 2025 ) , LiSoNav-Eval spans more scenes and includes more subtasks per sequence. Besides, LiSoNav-Eval also supports evaluation of both knowledge reuse and adaptation to object relocation.
blocks.zh: 数据集统计. 如表1所显示,LiSoNav-Eval包含来自28个HM3D场景的145个终生导航序列,包括由45个类别和82个小对象实例组成的500集和1,199个子任务. 其中545项(45.45%)涉及迁移目标。 每个导航序列平均包含8.27个子任务. 相较于OpenIN(Tang等,2025年),LiSoNav-Eval跨出更多的场景并包括了更多的每个序列的子任务. 此外,LiSoNav-Eval还支持对知识再利用和适应对象迁移的评价.

blocks.en:
Figure 2: Overview of IVAM-Nav. IVAM-Nav maintains a viewpoint-anchored graph memory through three processes:
(a) Memory construction with multi-view inspection actively observes supporting surfaces from complementary viewpoints to acquire reliable small-object evidence.
(b) Viewpoint-anchored memory reuse aggregates relational evidence around historical viewpoints to retrieve those relevant to the current query.
(c) Viewpoint-anchored memory revalidation and update revisits retrieved historical viewpoints to verify memory under similar viewing conditions and locally update inconsistent information.
blocks.zh:
图2:IVAM-Nav概览. IVAM-Nav通过三个过程保持了观点-不确定的图形内存:
(a) 利用多视图检查进行记忆构造,从互补的角度积极观察辅助表面,以获取可靠的小物体证据。
(b) 环绕历史观点查看点-未知的内存再利用汇总相关证据,以检索与当前查询有关的证据。
(c) 重新验证和更新取回的历史观点,以核实在类似查看条件下的内存,并在当地更新不一致的信息。

blocks.en: 4 IVAM-Nav
blocks.zh: 4个IVAM-Nav

blocks.en:
To handle this challenging task, we propose IVAM-Nav, which is designed to actively inspect supporting surfaces from multiple viewpoints for reliable small-object perception and anchor its memory to these viewpoints. For the first task in a new environment, the agent searches for and navigates to a supporting surface where the target may be located. It then samples nearby viewpoints and retains a small complementary set to obtain clear observations of the supporting surface. These observations, together with their poses and related scene information, form a viewpoint-anchored graph memory.
For subsequent subtasks, the agent aggregates the small-object and supporting-surface memories attached to each historical viewpoint and evaluates their relevance to the target query to retrieve the most relevant viewpoint. This design enables the agent to revisit previously recorded viewpoints and verify memory under similar viewing conditions.
blocks.zh:
为了完成这项具有挑战性的任务,我们提议IVAM-Nav,它旨在从多个角度积极检查支持的表面,以获取可靠的小物体感知,并将其内存固定在这些观点上. 对于新环境中的第一个任务,代理搜索并导航到目标可能所在的支持地表. 然后,它取样附近的观点,并保留一个小的补充集,以获得对支撑地表的明确观测. 这些观察,连同它们的姿势和相关场景信息,形成了一种观点-焦虑的图记.
对于以后的子任务,代理将每个历史视角所附带的小对象和辅助表面记忆相加,并评价它们与目标查询的相关性以取回最相关的视角. 这种设计使得代理商能够在类似的取景条件下重新审视之前所记录的观点并验证内存.

blocks.en: 4.1 Overall Framework
blocks.zh: 4.1 总框架

blocks.en: IVAM-Nav is a navigation framework built on a viewpoint-anchored graph memory. It comprises three core processes: (a) memory construction with multi-view inspection, (b) viewpoint-anchored memory reuse, and (c) viewpoint-anchored memory revalidation and update, as shown in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh: IVAM-Nav是一个基于视角-所选择的图记的导航框架. 它包括三个核心进程:(a) 多视图检查的内存构建;(b) 视角-安放内存再利用;(c) 视角-安放内存再验证和更新,如图2所示。

blocks.en: For each navigation subtask, the agent first queries the memory and revisits relevant historical viewpoints. At each revisited viewpoint, it checks the current observation for the target and compares it with the stored observation to assess memory validity. Detected inconsistencies trigger reobservation and updates at viewpoints associated with the same supporting surface. When useful historical candidates are unavailable or exhausted, the agent explores unobserved regions and actively inspects selected supporting surfaces, constructing new memories for subsequent tasks. The agent stops once the MLLM confirms the target in a current observation. Next we detail the three core processes.
blocks.zh: 对于每个导航子任务,代理首先会查询内存并重温相关的历史观点. 在每一个重新审视的视角中,它检查当前对目标的观察,并将其与存储的观察进行比较,以评估内存有效性. 探测到的不一致现象引发了在同一支持表面相关的观点上的再观测和更新。 当有用的历史考生没有或耗尽时,代理人会探索未观测到的区域并积极检查选定的辅助地表,为以后的任务构建出新的记忆. 一旦MLLM在当前观察中确认目标,特工就停止. 接下来我们详细介绍三个核心进程。

blocks.en: 4.2 Persistent Viewpoint-Anchored Graph Memory
blocks.zh: 4.2 持续取景点-安图内存

blocks.en: The memory of IVAM-Nav is initialized empty and progressively accumulated throughout the entire lifelong navigation sequence. As shown in Figure 2 (d), it is organized as a viewpoint-anchored graph 𝒢 = ( 𝒱 , ℰ ) \mathcal{G}=(\mathcal{V},\mathcal{E}) with viewpoint , surface , and object nodes. Viewpoint nodes store observations and camera poses, while surface and object nodes store semantic descriptions and embeddings and are connected to their observation viewpoints. Viewpoints observing the same surface are connected, while nearby distinct surfaces are linked, enabling relational aggregation during retrieval. Historical viewpoints thus serve as anchors for memory retrieval and preserve the poses needed for revalidation under similar viewing conditions.
blocks.zh: 对IVAM-Nav的记忆被初始化为空并在整个终生导航序列中逐渐积累. 如图2(d)所示,其排列方式为正视-安分图 G = (V, E)\mathcal{ (\mathcal{V},\mathcal{E}) 有正视,表面,对象节点. Viewpoint节点存储观测和相机的姿势,而地表和对象节点存储语义描述和嵌入并与其观测视角相接. 观测同一地表的取景点是相接的,而相邻的明显地表是相接的,使得在取取景时能够进行关系聚合. 历史观点因此成为了内存检索的锚地,并保留了在类似取景条件下重新验证所需的姿势.

blocks.en: 4.3 Memory Construction with Multi-View Inspection
blocks.zh: 4.3 内存建设与多维检查

blocks.en:
To construct reliable memory, IVAM-Nav combines frontier-based exploration with active multi-view inspection of selected supporting surfaces, as illustrated in Figure 2 (a). During exploration, RGB-D observations are used to detect and segment supporting surfaces, which are projected onto a top-down semantic map using depth and camera poses. Based on the target instruction, an MLLM selects either a frontier for further exploration or a nearby supporting surface for multi-view inspection. If a surface is selected, the agent samples viewpoints around it based on the semantic map (Step 1).
The agent then visits the sampled viewpoints to acquire close-range observations (Step 2). For each viewpoint v v , we define its reliable observation region ℛ ⁡ ( v ) \mathcal{R}(v) as the visible surface region within a predefined observation range, visualized by the mask in Step 2 of Figure 2 (a). We then select a compact complementary subset that jointly covers the supporting surface (Step 3) by greedily maximizing the additional reliable surface coverage: v ∗ = arg ⁡ max v ∈ 𝒞 ∖ 𝒮 ⁡ | ℛ ⁡ ( v ) ∖ ⋃ u ∈ 𝒮 ℛ ⁡ ( u ) | | ℛ surf | , v^{*}=\arg\max_{v\in\mathcal{C}\setminus\mathcal{S}}\frac{\left|\mathcal{R}(v)\setminus\bigcup_{u\in\mathcal{S}}\mathcal{R}(u)\right|}{|\mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{surf}}|}, (1) where 𝒞 \mathcal{C} and 𝒮 \mathcal{S} denote the visited and selected viewpoint sets, respectively, ℛ surf \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{surf}} is the supporting-surface region, and | ⋅ | |\cdot| denotes the area of a region. Selection stops once the required coverage is reached, reducing redundant observations while preserving reliable small-object information across the supporting surface. For each selected viewpoint, we mask regions beyond the reliable observation range in the corresponding view. We then use an MLLM to describe the visible small objects and supporting surface, and encode the resulting descriptions into semantic embeddings (Step 4). These scene elements are associated with their observation viewpoints and integrated into the graph (Step 5), with semantically consistent observations of the same supporting surface merged into a shared surface node.
blocks.zh:
为了构建可靠的内存,IVAM-Nav将基于前沿的探索与对选定的辅助地表的积极多视图检查结合起来,如图2(a)所显示. 在勘探过程中,使用RGB-D观测来探测并分解辅助地表,这些地表被投射到使用深度和相机姿势的自上而下语义图上. 根据目标指示,MLLM选择一个前沿进行进一步探索,或选择附近的辅助地表进行多视图检查。 如果选择了表面,该剂会根据语义图(步骤1)对周围的视点进行取样.
代理人随后访问被取样的视点,以获取近距离观测(步骤2)。 对于每个视图 v. 我们定义其可靠的观测区域 R \ (v)\ mathcal{R} (v) 是预定义的观测范围内的可见地表区域,由图2(a) 第2步中的口罩可视化. 然后我们选择一个紧凑的互补子集,通过贪婪地尽量扩大额外的可靠地表覆盖范围来共同覆盖支持地表(第3步):v * = arg max = max = max = ∈ C = ∖ S = | R ⁡ (v) * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * ** ·马特* ·** ·* ·* ·马特克** ·马特克*** ·** · ·马特尔{ · · · · · · · · · (1) C \ mathcal{C} 和 S \ mathcal{S} 分别表示访问的和选定的观点组合, R \ mathcal{ R}_{\ mathrm{ surf}} 是支持- 表面区域, 和 \\\\\ cdot| 表示一个区域的区域 。 一旦达到要求的覆盖范围,选择就会停止,减少多余的观测,同时在整个支持面保存可靠的小物体信息. 对于每一个选定的观点,我们在相应的视角中掩盖了超过可靠观测范围的区域. 然后我们用一个MLLM来描述可见的小物体和支撑的表面,并将所得出的描述编码为语义嵌入(Step 4. 这些场景元素与其观测视角相关并被整合到图中(第5步),对同一支撑地表的精密一致的观测被合并为一个共享地表节点.

blocks.en: 4.4 Viewpoint-Anchored Memory Reuse
blocks.zh: 4.4 视图点-安心记忆重用

blocks.en: Memory reuse allows accumulated scene knowledge to guide subsequent navigation, but noisy or incomplete small-object information can make direct object-level retrieval unreliable. IVAM-Nav therefore treats historical viewpoints as retrieval anchors and evaluates them using the object, surface, and surroundings information associated with each viewpoint, as shown in Figure 2 (b). The instruction is decomposed into object, surface, and surroundings queries and encoded into the same semantic space as the corresponding memory information.
blocks.zh: 内存再利用允许累积的场景知识来指导后续的导航,但吵闹或不完整的小对象信息可以使直接的对象级检索不可靠. 因此,IVAM-Nav将历史观点视为取回锚,并使用与每种观点相关的对象、地表和周围信息加以评价,如图2(b)所示。 该指令被分解为对象,地表,和周围的查询,并编码为与相应的内存信息相同的语义空间.

blocks.en: For each viewpoint node, we aggregate query-relevant information within its two-hop graph neighborhood, capturing sufficient local context while limiting unrelated information. The object and surface queries are matched with directly connected object and surface nodes, respectively, such as O1 and S1 for V1 in the figure. The second hop further uses object information from neighboring viewpoints and surroundings information from nearby surfaces. The highest-scoring viewpoints are selected for revisit and memory revalidation.
blocks.zh: 对于每个观点节点,我们把与查询相关的信息集中到其双跳相邻的图表中,捕捉到足够的局部上下文,同时限制无关的信息. 对象和地表查询分别与直接相接的物体和地表节点相匹配,如图中为V1的O1和S1. 第二跳进一步使用来自相邻观点的物体信息以及相邻地表的周边信息. 评分最高的观点被选为再审和内存再验证.

blocks.en: 4.5 Viewpoint-Anchored Memory Revalidation and Update
blocks.zh: 4.5 Viewpoint-Anchored 内存调整与更新

blocks.en:
A retrieved viewpoint provides both a target-search location and an observation reference for memory revalidation. As shown in Figure 2 (c), IVAM-Nav revisits the viewpoint and uses an MLLM to compare the new observation with the stored view under similar viewing conditions, focusing on small-object presence and spatial arrangement. This reduces viewpoint-induced variation, making inconsistencies more indicative of actual scene changes.
When an inconsistency is detected, IVAM-Nav follows graph relations to re-observe related viewpoints sharing the same surface and updates their small-object descriptions and embeddings. This relation-guided revision removes stale local information without unnecessary global memory reconstruction.
blocks.zh:
检索到的视角既提供了目标搜索位置,也提供了对内存重新验证的观测参考. 如图2(c)所显示,IVAM-Nav重新审视了观点,并使用MLLM在类似取景条件下将新观测与被存储的取景进行比较,并侧重于小对象的存在和空间安排. 这减少了观点引起的变化,使不一致更能说明实际场景的变化。
当检测出不一致时,IVAM-Nav遵循图关系,重新观测共享同一表面的相关观点并更新其小对象描述和嵌入. 这种由关系指导的修订在不进行不必要的全局内存重建的情况下去除已过时的本地信息.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5个实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Baselines. We select representative baselines with different cross-task memory capabilities. VLFM ( Yokoyama et al., 2024 ) provides a reference without cross-task memory. AstraNav ( Hu et al., 2026 ) and 3D-Mem ( Yang et al., 2025 ) retain and reuse scene knowledge across tasks but do not explicitly revise stale information, whereas DualMap ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) and DynaMem ( Liu et al., 2025 ) additionally incorporate mechanisms for adapting stored scene information to environmental changes. Together, these methods provide comparisons across navigation without cross-task memory, cross-task memory reuse, and memory adaptation under scene changes.
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们选择具有不同跨任务记忆能力的代表性基线. VLFM (Yokoyama等, 2024) 提供了没有交叉任务记忆的参考. AstraNav(Hu等,2026年)和3D-Mem(Yang等,2025年)在任务中保留和再利用场景知识,但没有明确修改陈旧信息,而DualMap(Jiang等,2025年)和DynaMem(Liu等,2025年)则进一步纳入了将所储存的场景信息适应环境变化的机制。 这些方法共同提供跨导航的比较,没有跨任务内存,跨任务内存再用,以及场景变化下的内存适应.

blocks.en: For a consistent task interface, all methods receive the same navigation instructions while retaining their core memory mechanisms. Since DualMap assumes a preconstructed scene map, we initialize it by traversing each environment along a predefined route before evaluation. We additionally report oracle variants of 3D-Mem and DynaMem with ground-truth small-object detections within 1 m. These variants reduce failures caused by small-object detection, allowing us to examine whether performance differences persist when this perceptual difficulty is partially alleviated. Details of baseline adaptations are provided in Appendix.
blocks.zh: 对于一个一致的任务接口,所有方法在保留其核心内存机制的同时,都收到相同的导航指令. 由于 DualMap 假设一个预先构建的场景地图,我们通过在评估前沿预先定义的路径穿过每个环境来初始化它. 我们另外报告3D-Mem和DynaMem的甲骨文变体,在1米以内进行地真小物体探测。 这些变体会减少由小对象检测所引发的故障,使我们能够在这种感知困难被部分缓解后检查性能差异是否持续存在. 基准调整的细节载于附录。

blocks.en: Evaluation metrics. We report Success Rate (SR) and Success weighted by Path Length (SPL) for overall navigation performance. To evaluate historical-memory retrieval, we additionally introduce Historical Revisit (HR) as a behavioral measure. Among subtasks with valid historical target observations, HR is the fraction of such subtasks for which the agent revisits within 1.5 m of a location where the target was previously observed. Whether a target was previously observed is determined using ground-truth simulator information, with detailed criteria provided in Appendix. To evaluate adaptation to object relocation, we further report Relocated-target SR , computed over subtasks whose targets have been relocated before the current task.
blocks.zh: 评价尺度。 我们报告成功率(SR)和成功率(SPL)按路径长度加权,用于总体导航性能。 为了评估历史记忆检索,我们还引入了历史回顾(HR)作为行为计量. 在具有有效历史目标观测结果的子任务中,HR是特工在先前观察到目标的地点1.5米以内重访的这类子任务的一小部分. 先前是否观察到目标,使用地面真实模拟器信息加以确定,并在附录中提供详细标准。 为了评估对对象迁移的适应性,我们进一步报告重新定位目标SR,从目标在目前任务之前已经迁移的子任务中计算。

blocks.en: Implementation details. IVAM-Nav uses YOLO-World ( Cheng et al., 2024 ) and SAM-L ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ) for supporting-surface perception, Qwen3-VL ( Bai et al., 2025 ) for MLLM-based operations, and BGE-small-en-v1.5 ( Xiao et al., 2024 ) for textual semantic embeddings. We use qwen3-vl-plus-2025-12-19 for all MLLM calls. For a controlled comparison, baseline components requiring MLLM inference also use the same model. Hyperparameters are fixed across all experiments, with further implementation details provided in Appendix.
blocks.zh: 执行细节。 IVAM-Nav使用YOLO-World(Cheng等,2024年)和SAM-L(Kirillov等,2023年)进行辅助表面感知,Qwen3-VL(Bai等,2025年)进行基于MLLM的操作,而BGE-small-en-v1.5(Xiao等,2024年)进行文字语义嵌入. 我们使用 qwen3 -vl -plus 2025 -12-19 所有 MLLM 电话。 为了进行有控制的比较,需要MLLM推论的基线组件也使用同一种模型. 在所有实验中都固定了超参数,附录中提供了进一步的实施细节。

blocks.en: 5.2 Overall Performance
blocks.zh: 5.2 总体业绩

blocks.en:
As shown in Table 2 , IVAM-Nav achieves an overall SR of 33.4% and SPL of 18.4%, outperforming all baselines in SR and remaining competitive in path efficiency. Notably, 3D-Mem Oracle and DynaMem Oracle achieve 27.5% and 20.1% SR despite receiving ground-truth small-object detection assistance, suggesting that alleviating small-object perception difficulty alone does not fully address LiSoNav-COL, where accumulated scene knowledge must also be effectively reused and maintained as object locations change. With an additional reference image, IVAM-Nav further reaches 36.3% SR and 21.3% SPL, indicating that improved target appearance information can provide additional benefits.
In addition, IVAM-Nav achieves an HR of 77.4%, substantially higher than the baselines, indicating that its memory frequently guides the agent back to previously observed target locations. However, high HR alone does not imply success in LiSoNav-COL, as historical locations may become outdated after object relocation and require revalidation. On relocated targets, IVAM-Nav achieves 30.5% SR, compared with 19.3% for 3D-Mem Oracle and 15.8% for DynaMem Oracle. Together, these results show that IVAM-Nav effectively reuses accumulated scene knowledge while remaining effective under object relocation.
blocks.zh:
如表2所示,IVAM-Nav的总的SR为33.4%,SPL为18.4%,超过了斯洛伐克共和国的所有基线,在路径效率方面仍然具有竞争力。 值得注意的是,3D-Mem Oracle和DynaMem Oracle尽管获得地面真能小物体探测协助,却取得了27.5%和20.1%的SR,这表明仅缓解小物体感知困难并不能完全解决LiSoNav-COL问题,在LiSoNav-COL中,积累的场景知识也必须随着物体位置的变化而得到有效的再利用和维护. 有了额外的参考图像,IVAM-Nav进一步达到了36.3%的SR和21.3%的SPL,表明改进的目标外观信息可以提供额外的好处.
此外,IVAM-Nav实现了77.4%的HR,大大高于基线,表明其内存经常引导剂返回先前观察到的目标位置. 然而,仅靠高HR并不意味着LiSoNav-COL的成功,因为历史地点在物体迁移后可能过时并需要重新验证. 在迁移目标上,IVAM-Nav实现了30.5%的SR,而3D-Mem Oracle为19.3%,DynaMem Oracle为15.8%. 这些结果显示,IVAM-Nav有效再利用所积累的场景知识,同时在物体迁移下依然有效.

blocks.en: Performance across episodes. Figure 3 reports the first three episodes shared by all sequences, excluding Episode 4 to ensure comparison over the same sequence set. Episode 1 contains no object relocation, while later episodes provide more accumulated memory for reuse but may also introduce stale memory through relocation. IVAM-Nav, with or without a reference image, maintains strong SR across episodes, while its SPL increases after Episode 1 and remains consistently higher thereafter, indicating sustained efficiency benefits from accumulated memory despite potential staleness. In contrast, other cross-task memory methods generally show larger SR degradation or less consistent SPL benefits in later episodes.
blocks.zh: 各集的表演. 图3报告所有序列共享的前三集,不包括第4集,以确保与同一组序列进行比较. 第1集没有包含对象迁移,而后集提供更多的累积内存再利用,但也可能通过迁移引入 stale内存. IVAM-Nav无论有无参考图像,在整个剧集中都保持了强大的SR,而其SPL在第1集后会增加,并在后始终保持较高水平,这表明尽管可能存在僵硬性,但积累的内存仍能持续提高效率。 相形之下,其他跨任务内存方法一般在后期节目中显示出更大的SR降解或不太一致的SPL好处.

blocks.en: 5.3 Method Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.3 方法分析

blocks.en: To enable efficient controlled analysis, we conduct the following experiments on a representative LiSoNav-Eval subset containing 245 subtasks, using the reference-image variant of IVAM-Nav to reduce target-recognition ambiguity and focus the analysis on its memory mechanisms. The representativeness of the subset is analyzed in Appendix, and its composition will be released.
blocks.zh: 为了能够进行有效的控制分析,我们利用IVAM-Nav的参考图像变体,对包含245个子任务的具有代表性的LiSoNav-Eval子集进行以下实验,以减少目标识别的模糊性并集中分析其内存机制. 附录中分析了子集的代表性,并将公布其组成。

blocks.en: Ablation study. We consider six variants. w/o memory removes cross-task memory entirely. w/o complementary viewpoints retains only one viewpoint near each supporting surface during memory construction. w/o graph aggregation matches memory candidates independently with the target object without aggregating graph information around historical viewpoints. w/o historical-viewpoint revisit navigates to the associated supporting surface for revalidation but does not return to the stored viewpoint. w/o memory update leaves inconsistent historical memory unchanged and continues to use it for subsequent navigation decisions. Finally, w/o contextual cues removes the surface and surroundings cues from the instruction, using only the small-object description for memory retrieval, to evaluate IVAM-Nav when such contextual information is unavailable.
blocks.zh: 校勘研究. 我们考虑六个变体。 w/o内存完全去除跨任务内存. w/o互补的观点在内存构造期间只保留了相邻每个支持面上的一个观点. w/o图集将内存候选人独立地与目标对象匹配,而不将图表信息围绕历史视角进行汇总. w/o 历史- 视图点重温导航到相关支持面进行再验证,但不会返回存储的视角. w/o 内存更新使不一致的历史内存保持不变,并继续用于后续的导航决定. 最后,w/o上下文提示会从指令中去除表面和周围提示,仅使用小对象描述来取回内存,在无法获得这种上下文信息时评价IVAM-Nav.

blocks.en:
As shown in Table 3 , removing cross-task memory reduces SPL from 21.38% to 9.18%, showing the benefit of accumulated memory for navigation efficiency. Retaining only a single viewpoint for each surface reduces SR from 36.73% to 26.12%, supporting the use of complementary viewpoints to obtain reliable small-object information. Without graph aggregation, SR decreases to 26.53%, showing that aggregating scene information around historical viewpoints improves memory retrieval over independently matching memory candidates.
Without historical-viewpoint revisit for revalidation, SR drops to 28.98%, showing the benefit of revisiting the original observation viewpoint under similar viewing conditions. Disabling memory update yields the largest SR drop, to 24.90%, highlighting the importance of revising stale memory rather than continuing to use it for subsequent decisions.
blocks.zh:
如表3所示,去除跨任务内存将SPL从21.38%降至9.18%,显示了累积内存对导航效率的好处. 仅保留每个地表的单个视点将SR从36.73%降至26.12%,支持使用互补视点来获取可靠的小对象信息. 没有图集,SR会下降到26.53%,显示围绕历史观点汇总场景信息比独立匹配的内存候选人会改善内存检索.
在不重审历史观点的情况下,SR降至28.98%,显示出在类似取景条件下重审原始观察观点的好处. 失效的内存更新产生最大的SR下降,为24.90%,凸显了修订 stale内存而非继续用于后续决策的重要性.

blocks.en: Finally, even without contextual cues, IVAM-Nav retains an SR of 30.20%, indicating that the method remains effective when it relies only on the small-object description.
blocks.zh: 最后,即使没有上下文提示,IVAM-Nav也保留了30.20%的SR,表示该方法仅依赖于小对象描述时依然有效.

blocks.en: Robustness to object relocation. To assess how robustly different methods handle object relocation and the resulting stale memory, we compare representative cross-task memory methods under static and changing-object-layout settings. The static setting removes cross-episode object relocation, with details provided in Appendix. As shown in Table 4 , IVAM-Nav exhibits the smallest degradation under scene changes, with relative SR and SPL drops of 10.0% and 16.4%, respectively. This indicates that IVAM-Nav is less affected by object relocation and the potentially stale memory it introduces. See Appendix for further analysis.
blocks.zh: 强力反对迁移. 为了评估不同方法如何有力处理对象迁移和由此而来被扭曲的内存,我们在静态和变化对象放出设置下比较有代表性的跨任务内存方法. 静态设置可以去除跨集对象迁移,详细情况见附录. 如表4所示,IVAM-Nav在场景变化中呈现出最小的降解,相对的SR和SPL分别下降10.0%和16.4%. 这表明IVAM-Nav受物体迁移的影响较小,并且它引入了可能陈旧的记忆. 进一步分析见附录。

blocks.en: 5.4 Benchmark Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.4 基准分析

blocks.en: We analyze LiSoNav-Eval along factors that affect small-object perception, target search, and adaptation to scene changes. As shown in Table 5 , most methods perform worse on smaller objects, reflecting the increased difficulty of acquiring reliable visual information when targets occupy a limited image area. Table 7 shows a clear performance decline as environment scale increases, indicating the greater exploration and search difficulty in larger spaces. For relocated targets, Table 6 shows that most methods perform worse under longer relocation distances, suggesting that larger location changes make recovery from outdated target memory more challenging.
blocks.zh: 我们分析LiSoNav-Eval与影响小对象感知、目标搜索和适应场景变化的因素。 如表5所示,大多数方法在较小的物体上表现更差,反映出在目标占据有限图像区域时获取可靠的视觉信息更加困难. 表7显示,随着环境尺度的扩大,性能明显下降,表明在较大空间的探索和搜索困难更大. 关于迁移目标,表6显示,在迁移距离较长的情况下,大多数方法表现更糟糕,表明更大的地点变化使得从过时的目标内存中恢复更具挑战性。

blocks.en: 6 Limitations and Future Directions
blocks.zh: 6 限制和未来方向

blocks.en: IVAM-Nav leaves several directions for future work. Active multi-view observation introduces additional navigation cost, motivating more cost-aware acquisition strategies. Memory revalidation is mainly triggered by retrieved historical viewpoints, motivating broader and opportunistic memory maintenance. Memory reuse and exploration are currently sequential and could be more tightly integrated. Finally, LiSoNav-Eval relocates small objects while keeping background scenes stable; future benchmarks could consider broader scene changes. See Appendix for further discussion.
blocks.zh: IVAM-Nav为今后的工作留下了几个方向。 积极的多视图观测引入了额外的导航成本,激发了更多成本意识的获取战略. 记忆再验证主要由被检索的历史观点所触发,激发更广泛的和机会性的记忆维护. 内存再利用和探索目前依次进行,可以更紧密地进行整合. 最后,LiSoNav-Eval移动了小物体,同时保持了背景场景的稳定;未来的基准可以考虑更广泛的场景变化. 进一步讨论见附录。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We introduced LiSoNav-COL, which studies lifelong small-object navigation from empty memory under changing object layouts, together with the LiSoNav-Eval benchmark. We further proposed IVAM-Nav, which combines multi-view inspection for reliable memory construction with viewpoint-anchored memory reuse and revalidation. Experiments show consistent improvements over existing navigation and scene-memory methods and validate the key designs of IVAM-Nav.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了LiSoNav-COL,它与LiSoNav-Eval基准一起,在改变对象布局下从空的内存中研究终身的小对象导航. 我们进一步提出IVAM-Nav,将可靠内存构建的多视图检查与观点不确定的内存再利用和再验证结合起来. 实验显示,在现有导航和场景模拟方法的基础上不断改进,验证了IVAM-Nav的关键设计.
